promises.label: FY27 effective tax rate guidance
promises.speaker: Saurabh Goel
promises.quote: Steady state effective tax rate guidance for FY27 is between 23% and 24%.

promises.label: FY27 Free Cash Flow to PAT
promises.speaker: Saurabh Goel
promises.quote: Looking ahead, we anticipate free cash flow to PAT to be maintained at 100% from FY27 onwards in contrast to our earlier guidance of 70 to 80%.

promises.label: FY27 revenue growth
promises.speaker: Sudhir Singh
promises.quote: We believe revenue growth will be robust. We are confident of achieving an EBITDA margin of 20.5% to 21% in FY27 on a consolidated basis.

reported.label: FY26 US dollar revenue growth
reported.speaker: Sudhir Singh
reported.quote: Moving on to the Annual Performance Review, I am pleased to share that FY26 was a very successful year for the firm. The firm grew 29.2% in U.S. dollar terms.

reported.label: Q4 FY26 EBIT margin
reported.speaker: Sudhir Singh
reported.quote: I would like to draw your attention to the fact that Q4 FY26 EBIT of the firm is 16.6%, while it was 12.3% in the same quarter a year back.

reported.label: Q4 order intake
reported.speaker: Sudhir Singh
reported.quote: Moving on to Order Intake - Q4 was a very strong quarter, both from an order intake and a large deal closure perspective. During the quarter, we signed five large deals. The total order intake during the quarter was 648 million US dollars.

reported.label: Executable order book
reported.speaker: Sudhir Singh
reported.quote: The executable order book, which reflects the total value of locked orders over the next 12 months, stands at a record 1.75 billion USD. This number is 16.4% higher than at the same time last year.
